answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond in a vault before its work earns emission. Honest agents recover it; caught misbehavior is slashed. A sybil operator must mirror that stake across every fake account, so a swarm of N clones costs N bonds, and one exposed cheater can burn the whole set. The gap between one honest deposit and a thousand forfeited ones becomes a canyon no rational attacker profits from crossing.
